parsed.main_gap: The central estimate (7) is asserted without the necessary algebra and case split according to the sign of d(y)-d(t).

errors.description: Estimate (7), on which the constancy argument entirely depends, is not proved. It does follow by separately treating b≥c via the lower inequality and c≥b via the upper inequality, but those essential deductions are absent.

parsed.notes: Apart from this readily repairable omitted calculation, the iterate argument, partition argument, classification, and converse are correct.
